name: Campingplatz Kesselberg
beschreibung: The Kesselberg campsite is located directly on the Kochelsee in Austrian Tirol and is surrounded by the impressive mountain world of the Alpen. The surrounding area invites a variety of outdoor activities such as hiking, cycling and water sports. The campsite's facilities include modern sanitary facilities and spacious pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. The quiet and natural atmosphere ensures a relaxing stay. The target audience is primarily nature lovers and families who appreciate an active holiday in the mountains. Water sports enthusiasts also appreciate the direct location on the lake for sailing and surfing trips.
